posts.body:
Hello all

Quick question regarding maternity allowance. My finish date is the 31/10/2013, with a payment due 25/10/2013.

Would anyone know if this would be my last one

And whether it will be for my full amount also? I get it paid every 4 weeks.

Would ring them but have tried and waited on phone so many times.

Many thanks

Beckie

posts.body:
You can calculate your mat pay here: https://www.gov.uk/calculate-your-maternity-pay

The first four weeks of mat pay is normally 90%.

I guess if your works months runs the full month then the 25/10 pay would be for the full amount.

posts.body:
I would say that your final payment would be for the days due up to the 31/10 so if your paid in arrears i would say it would be your normal amount plus the extra 6 days.

Or they might pay you your normal then a smaller payment on the 31st. probably be best to try getting through to them to confirm.
